# Scanners-Box 每日 AI 工具推荐 (Scanners-Box Daily AI Tool Picks)

> 面向极客、企业与 AI 智能体的全域开源网络安全工具矩阵：每天精选一个开源 AI 安全工具，附中英文深度点评、能力短板与适用边界。
> The Ultimate Open-Source Security Arsenal for Hackers, Enterprises, and AI Agents: one curated open-source AI security tool per day, with in-depth bilingual notes, honest caveats and fitness boundaries.

本文件为 AI/LLM 爬虫提供站点结构摘要。完整站点地图见 https://we5ter.github.io/sitemap.xml。
This file summarizes the site structure for AI/LLM crawlers. Full sitemap: https://we5ter.github.io/sitemap.xml.

## 工具目录 / Directory

- [每日 AI 工具推荐总览 / Daily AI Tool Picks index](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/): 全部已发布期号，支持分类筛选、按日期/热度/GitHub star 排序与全文搜索。All published issues with category filters, date/trending/star sorting and full-text search.

## 每日推荐 / Daily Picks

- [024 AIMap](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/aimap/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/aimap/): 公网 AI 服务的攻击面地图：32 条 Shodan 查询找出暴露的 MCP/Ollama/vLLM，Nuclei 验明协议与工具，0–10 风险打分，再按协议跑攻击验证 · An attack-surface map for AI services on the open internet: 32 Shodan queries surface exposed MCP/Ollama/vLLM endpoints, Nuclei fingerprints protocol and tools, a 0–10 risk score ranks them, then protocol engines verify the damage · 分类/Category: AI Infrastructure Attack Surface Discovery · GitHub: https://github.com/BishopFox/aimap (443 stars)
- [023 DeepTeam](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/deepteam/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/deepteam/): 红队测试 + 生产护栏两半都包：一个 LLM 现写攻击、一个 LLM 判定、失败带 CVSS；测出来的偏见/PII/提示注入，线上挂 7 个守卫直接拦 · Red teaming and production guardrails in one framework: one LLM writes the attacks, another judges each case, failures carry CVSS — and the bias/PII/prompt injection the tests surface get blocked live by 7 guards · 分类/Category: AI Red Teaming Frameworks & Agents · GitHub: https://github.com/confident-ai/deepteam (3061 stars)
- [022 OWASP AISVS](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/owasp-aisvs/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/owasp-aisvs/): 不是又一份 AI 风险 Top 10：它把训练数据、RAG 记忆、Agent 与 MCP 拆成 213 条可验证要求，告诉团队具体该做什么、做完怎么验 · Not another AI-risk Top 10: 213 testable requirements across training data, RAG memory, agents and MCP — turning security principles into reviewable, testable engineering objects · 分类/Category: AI Security Verification Standards · GitHub: https://github.com/OWASP/AISVS (565 stars)
- [021 mcp-scanner](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/mcp-scanner/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/mcp-scanner/): Cisco 开源的 MCP 服务器安检：YARA + LLM + AI Defense 三引擎并联，共 9 个分析器；最值钱的是报告纪律——扫描没跑完 is_safe 返回 None，不许说安全 · Cisco's open-source security screening for MCP servers — YARA + LLM + AI Defense in parallel, nine analyzers; the real prize is the reporting discipline: an unfinished scan returns is_safe=None, never "safe" · 分类/Category: AI Infrastructure Attack Surface Discovery · GitHub: https://github.com/cisco-ai-defense/mcp-scanner (1094 stars)
- [020 agent-sandbox](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/agent-sandbox/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/agent-sandbox/): Kubernetes SIG Apps 官方出品：把「一个长期活着、有稳定名字、带自己磁盘的单容器」补成 Sandbox 这层 API，隔离一行代码都不自己写，全交给 gVisor / Kata · Official Kubernetes SIG Apps project: turns "one long-lived container with a stable name and its own disk" into a first-class API — and writes zero isolation code itself, delegating it all to gVisor / Kata · 分类/Category: AI Agent Runtime Controls · GitHub: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/agent-sandbox (4270 stars)
- [019 h5i](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/h5i/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/h5i/): 把 Burp 那一层重做成 Agent 原生工作台：浏览器驱动 + 抓包改包重放 + 沙箱 box + Lean 4 形式化验证，纪律条款编译进二进制 · The Burp layer rebuilt as an agent-native workbench — browser driving, HTTP capture/tamper/replay, sandbox boxes and Lean 4 proofs, with the discipline compiled into the binary · 分类/Category: Security Toolkits for Agentic Workflows · GitHub: https://github.com/h5i-dev/h5i (775 stars)
- [018 LLMFuzzer](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/llmfuzzer/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/llmfuzzer/): 自称「首个 LLM 模糊测试框架」的 100 行 PoC：其实不 fuzz、无模型在环，判定靠子串匹配——但那个确定性 oracle 是整类注入检测的地基 · A 100-line PoC self-billed as "the first LLM fuzzing framework" — it doesn't fuzz, no model in the loop, verdict is a substring match; but that deterministic oracle is the foundation of the whole injection-detection class · 分类/Category: Security Auditing for AI Agents & Apps · GitHub: https://github.com/mnns/LLMFuzzer (383 stars)
- [017 Cloudflare security-audit-skill](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/cloudflare-security-audit-skill/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/cloudflare-security-audit-skill/): Cloudflare 官方的 coding-agent skill：6 阶段编排，查 findings 的 agent 永远不是发现它的那个 agent · Cloudflare's official coding-agent skill: a six-phase orchestration where the agent verifying a finding is never the agent that found it · 分类/Category: Agent Skills for Vulnerability Discovery & Remediation · GitHub: https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill (22616 stars)
- [016 Cisco Skill Scanner](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/cisco-skill-scanner/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/cisco-skill-scanner/): Cisco AI Defense 的 skill 扫描器：9 个分析引擎 + cel-go 类型化决策层，敢把 7.75% 召回率原样写进 README · Cisco AI Defense's skill scanner: nine analysis engines over a typed cel-go decision layer, brave enough to publish a 7.75% recall in its README · 分类/Category: Security Auditing for Agent Skills · GitHub: https://github.com/cisco-ai-defense/skill-scanner (2561 stars)
- [015 NVIDIA SkillSpector](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/skillspector/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/skillspector/): 回答「这个 skill 装了安全吗」：71 个漏洞模式 × 17 类别，静态 + 可选 LLM 语义两阶段，SARIF 直接进 CI · Answers "is this skill safe to install?": 71 vulnerability patterns across 17 categories, static plus optional LLM semantic analysis, SARIF straight into CI · 分类/Category: Security Auditing for Agent Skills · GitHub: https://github.com/NVIDIA/SkillSpector (18488 stars)
- [014 Rebuff](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/rebuff/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/rebuff/): prompt injection 防御史上的绕不开的一章：canary token 检测 + 向量库自我加固的四层防线（仓库已归档，按史料读） · An unavoidable chapter in prompt-injection defense history: canary-token detection plus vector-store self-hardening across four layers (archived — read it as history) · 分类/Category: Security Auditing for AI Agents & Apps · GitHub: https://github.com/protectai/rebuff (1522 stars)
- [013 garak](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/garak/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/garak/): NVIDIA 的 LLM 漏洞扫描器：懂 nmap / Metasploit 的话，garak 对 LLM 干的是差不多的事 · NVIDIA's LLM vulnerability scanner: if you know nmap / Metasploit, garak does roughly the same thing to LLMs · 分类/Category: LLM-Powered Vulnerability Scanners · GitHub: https://github.com/NVIDIA/garak (9373 stars)
- [012 Vigolium](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/vigolium/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/vigolium/): 双引擎漏洞扫描器：208 主动 + 117 被动 Native 模块打底，Go 版 agentic 运行时（Autopilot / Swarm）在上 · A dual-engine vulnerability scanner: 208 active + 117 passive native modules underneath, a Go agentic runtime (Autopilot / Swarm) on top · 分类/Category: LLM-Powered Vulnerability Scanners · GitHub: https://github.com/vigolium/vigolium (1085 stars)
- [011 deepsec](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/deepsec/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/deepsec/): Vercel Labs 的 agent 驱动漏洞扫描器：不扫 diff、不扫增量，对存量大型仓库做一次全量深挖 · Vercel Labs' agent-driven vulnerability scanner: no diffs, no increments — one full-depth audit of an existing large codebase · 分类/Category: LLM-Powered Vulnerability Scanners · GitHub: https://github.com/vercel-labs/deepsec (8044 stars)
- [010 Dark-Moon](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/dark-moon/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/dark-moon/): 把真实 IP / 主机 / URL / 凭证在本地换成确定性占位符、只在工具执行那一刻还原：50 个专家 agent + 140+ 真实工具的自主渗透平台 · Real IPs, hosts, URLs and credentials become deterministic local placeholders, restored only at tool-execution time: an autonomous pentest platform with 50 specialist agents and 140+ real tools · 分类/Category: AI Red Teaming Frameworks & Agents · GitHub: https://github.com/ASCIT31/Dark-Moon (975 stars)
- [009 LuaN1ao](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/luan1ao-agent/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/luan1ao-agent/): 把每条渗透结论钉回证据链：P-E-O 三角色 + 三图分离 + Evidence→Hypothesis→Vulnerability→Exploit 因果链 · Pinning every pentest finding to evidence: Planner-Executor-Observer roles + three graph separations + an enforced Evidence → Hypothesis → Vulnerability → Exploit chain · 分类/Category: AI Red Teaming Frameworks & Agents · GitHub: https://github.com/SanMuzZzZz/LuaN1aoAgent (1316 stars)
- [008 Agent Governance Toolkit](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/agent-governance-toolkit/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/agent-governance-toolkit/): 微软开源的 AI Agent 运行时管控套件：把「请 AI 守规矩」换成「让 AI 没法不守规矩」 · Microsoft's runtime governance suite for AI agents: from "asking AI to behave" to "making it structurally incapable of misbehaving" · 分类/Category: AI Agent Runtime Controls · GitHub: https://github.com/microsoft/agent-governance-toolkit (6352 stars)
- [007 AgentShield](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/agentshield/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/agentshield/): Claude Code 黑客松作品 / Everything Claude Code 生态：把 AI Agent 配置审计做成 0–100 分、可上 CI 的合规工具 · A Claude Code Hackathon project from the Everything Claude Code ecosystem: a 0–100 graded audit of AI agent configurations that drops into CI as a compliance gate · 分类/Category: Security Auditing for AI Agents & Apps · GitHub: https://github.com/affaan-m/agentshield (1232 stars)
- [006 AI-Infra-Guard](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/ai-infra-guard/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/ai-infra-guard/): 腾讯朱雀实验室的全栈 AI 红队平台：五层能力覆盖 AI 基础设施 CVE、Agent 失控、MCP 供应链、Skill 后门与越狱评测 · A full-stack AI red teaming platform from Tencent Zhuque Lab: five capabilities spanning AI infrastructure CVEs, agent loss of control, the MCP supply chain, skill backdoors and jailbreak evaluation · 分类/Category: Security Auditing for AI Agents & Apps · GitHub: https://github.com/Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard (6623 stars)
- [005 NVIDIA OpenShell](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/openshell-nvidia-agent-runtime/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/openshell-nvidia-agent-runtime/): 面向自主 AI Agent 的安全私有运行时：用声明式 YAML 策略在文件系统、网络、进程、凭证四个维度设界，凭证只在策略放行后注入授权端点 · A safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents: declarative YAML policies enforce boundaries across filesystem, network, process and provider access, and credentials only flow into policy-admitted endpoints · 分类/Category: AI Agent Runtime Controls · GitHub: https://github.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell (9087 stars)
- [004 PentAGI](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/pentagi-autonomous-pentest-platform/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/pentagi-autonomous-pentest-platform/): 全自主渗透平台：Docker 沙箱里跑 20+ 工具，13 个 agent 角色分工，四道闸门防止跑飞 · A fully autonomous pentesting platform: 20+ tools in a Docker sandbox, 13 specialized agent roles, and four supervision gates to stop runaway runs · 分类/Category: AI Red Teaming Frameworks & Agents · GitHub: https://github.com/vxcontrol/pentagi (25071 stars)
- [003 Cairn](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/cairn-state-space-search/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/cairn-state-space-search/): 通用状态空间搜索引擎：不定义角色与工作流，给起点和终点，让 Agent 在黑板上自己搜路 · A general state-space search engine: no roles, no workflows — hand it an origin and a goal and let agents find the path on a shared blackboard · 分类/Category: AI Red Teaming Frameworks & Agents · GitHub: https://github.com/oritera/Cairn (3124 stars)
- [002 Shannon](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/shannon-ai-pentester/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/shannon-ai-pentester/): AI 渗透测试 Agent：读源码找攻击面，再真打一遍验证，只有跑通 PoC 的漏洞才进报告 · An AI pentesting agent: read the source, map attack paths, then prove every finding with a real exploit — no PoC, no report. · 分类/Category: AI Red Teaming Frameworks & Agents · GitHub: https://github.com/KeygraphHQ/shannon (48455 stars)
- [001 CyberStrikeAI](https://we5ter.github.io/ai-tools/cyberstrikeai-ai-native-security-hub/) (EN: https://we5ter.github.io/en/ai-tools/cyberstrikeai-ai-native-security-hub/): AI 原生的安全执行中枢：把自然语言意图转成受治理的行动，并把证据沉淀成可复用的运营记忆 · An AI-native security execution hub: turns natural-language intent into governed action and bakes evidence into reusable operational memory. · 分类/Category: AI Red Teaming Frameworks & Agents · GitHub: https://github.com/AIPentest/CyberStrikeAI (7074 stars)
